title: Episode About the Sacrifice of Elder Sahibzadas

blocks.text: The battle of Chamkaur kept intensifying around the small fortress, and the sacrifice of the elder Sahibzadas had already become part of the struggle unfolding there. (4–6)
Nahar Khan and then Khwaja Khaizar were drawn into the fighting, but Guru Gobind Singh’s defiance broke their nerve even as they tried to press the siege harder. (7–10)
By the end of the day the enemy had only tightened the cordon, while inside the garrison there was almost nothing left to eat and scarcely any space or shelter from the assault. (11–12)
